about: Questions written blind from merged nodejs/node PRs (June to November 2026) and a few common contributor tasks, without seeing the docs; answers labeled separately against the pinned docs.

labeling.method: Two independent labelers per question (one starting from the doc list, one from grep); a third agent reconciled every disagreement on the merits.

cases.task: deps: V8: cherry-pick 8d14d49c4040
cases.question: How do I cherry-pick an upstream V8 commit into deps/v8, and what else must change besides the patched files?
cases.note: Manual: git am --directory=deps/v8, commit format, bump v8_embedder_string in common.gypi; git node v8 backport automates it.

cases.task: doc: clarify that V8 major upgrade uses stable release
cases.question: When upgrading deps/v8 to a new major version, should we use V8's stable release or a newer beta branch?
cases.note: Major updates: upgrade once V8 finishes stable promotion; use a fresh checkout of the latest stable branch.

cases.task: deps: update zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley-9f9f52c
cases.question: Our bundled zlib has a version like 1.3.2.1-motley; where is it sourced from and how do I update it?
cases.note: zlib comes from Chromium's zlib fork; updates by the weekly action or a tools/update-deps script. 'motley' not explained.

cases.task: tools: skip dependency update if PR has non-bot commits
cases.question: How does the automated job that opens dependency update PRs work, and which dependencies does it handle?
cases.note: Weekly dependency-update-action (tools.yml) covers most deps; OpenSSL has its own action, npm uses npm-cli-bot. Brief.

cases.task: deps: patch npm engines to accept alpha versions
cases.question: Can I patch files in a vendored dependency like deps/npm directly in a Node PR, or must changes go upstream first?
cases.note: Send deps/ changes to their upstream projects; updates accepted only once landed upstream, with case-by-case TSC exceptions.

cases.task: tools: keep OpenSSL update PRs in draft until arch configs committed
cases.question: The OpenSSL update PR fails to build because the architecture-specific configs weren't regenerated; how do I regenerate and commit them?
cases.note: Step 2: make -C deps/openssl/config (or make gen-openssl). Step 4: git add -A the config dirs and commit.

cases.task: test: keep objects alive in finalization fixtures
cases.question: How do I make a single test file run with extra node flags like --expose-gc when executed by tools/test.py?
cases.note: Add a '// Flags: ...' comment in the test preamble; the test runner applies those flags.

cases.task: build: fix gtest integration
cases.question: How do I build and run only the C++ gtest unit tests, and filter to a single test case?
cases.note: make cctest; filter with GTEST_FILTER=... or run out/Release/cctest --gtest_filter=...

cases.task: test: remove duplicate `common` imports
cases.question: Does every test file have to require('../common') at the top even when it doesn't use it, and why?
cases.note: Yes, require('../common') before other modules even if unused; it fails tests that leak globals.

cases.task: test: deflake test-filehandle-close
cases.question: My test is flaky on slow CI machines because it waits on a fixed setTimeout; how should tests handle timers?
cases.note: Timers: avoid timers since they cause flakiness; if one is needed, use common.platformTimeout() to get longer timeouts on slow platforms.

cases.task: test: deflake test-worker-message-port-transfer-filehandle-fd0
cases.question: A worker test fails intermittently on CI but never locally; how can I run it many times on CI to reproduce?
cases.note: The node-stress-single-test Jenkins job runs a group of tests over and over on a specific platform to check for flakiness.

cases.task: benchmark: add util.parseArgs benchmark
cases.question: How is a benchmark file under benchmark/ structured — how do createBenchmark configs, bench.start() and bench.end(n) fit together?
cases.note: Covers the createBenchmark(main, configs, options) arguments, bench.start()/bench.end(n), the two-pass run, and a full example.

cases.task: lib: optimize TextEncoder.encode for short strings
cases.question: How do I benchmark my TextEncoder change against a main build and show the improvement is statistically significant?
cases.note: Build main and PR binaries, run benchmark/compare.js --old/--new with --analyze (Welch t-test), and read the confidence stars.

cases.task: util: make mime parsing faster
cases.question: Why does lib/ code use primordials like StringPrototypeSlice instead of calling methods directly, and do they slow down hot paths?
cases.note: Primordials wrap the original prototype methods so userland changes can't break core. The doc lists primordials known to slow hot paths. The intro adds context.

cases.task: lib: speed up AbortSignal
cases.question: For internal state on lib/ classes like AbortSignal, should I use Symbol() or Symbol.for(), and how should they be named?
cases.note: Short doc: Symbol('kField') for private-like internal fields; Symbol.for only with a 'nodejs.' prefix for developer-facing metaprogramming.

cases.task: doc,lib,src: throw on missing WebAssembly or RX support
cases.question: How do I add a new ERR_* error code to lib/internal/errors.js, and where do new codes get documented?
cases.note: Append the code with E(key, message, Base) in internal/errors.js and document it in doc/api/errors.md (run make lint-clean if lint misses it).

cases.task: ffi: throw on allocation failure in toArrayBuffer()
cases.question: Should C++ binding code throw JavaScript exceptions directly, or return an error status so the JS side builds and throws the error?
cases.note: Return error data (or fill a ctx object) from C++ and build and throw the error in JS with internal/errors. Throw from C++ only close to the return to JS.

cases.task: ffi: fix handle leak in fast buffer arguments
cases.question: What is a V8 fast API callback not allowed to do — can it create handles, allocate, call into JS, or throw?
cases.note: Intro (H1): no-re-entry/no-throw limits lifted in V8 12.6; handles need options.isolate plus HandleScope; throwing needs options arg.

cases.task: http2: release queued data memory on stream cancellation
cases.question: Memory keeps growing when http2 streams are cancelled; how do I track down a native memory leak in src/ with valgrind?
cases.note: Rerun valgrind with --leak-check=full for allocation stacks; for src/ leaks build ./configure --debug, run out/Debug node.

cases.task: fs: add mkstemp()
cases.question: When documenting a new API in doc/api, what version goes in the YAML added: field before the release exists?
cases.note: Use REPLACEME in added:/introduced_in; releasers replace it with the real version at release time.

cases.task: doc: ffi rename OS/400 -> IBM i
cases.question: How long must a pull request stay open before it can land, and can a trivial doc fix be fast-tracked?
cases.note: Wait 48 hours; doc-only or trivial changes can land sooner (fast-track label plus two collaborator approvals).

cases.task: crypto: reject immutable random fill buffers
cases.question: Is making an API throw on input it previously accepted a semver-major change, and what approvals does a breaking change need?
cases.note: Adding errors is listed as a breaking change; backward-incompatible changes need approval from two TSC voting members.

cases.task: deps,lib,tools: remove jitless and lite modes
cases.question: Before removing a command-line flag like --jitless, must it be deprecated first, and how do the deprecation stages progress?
cases.note: Stable public APIs need deprecation before removal: documentation-only, then runtime, then End-of-Life, with deprecation-cycle rules.

cases.task: tls: add tlsSocket.socket, to access the raw stream beneath TLS
cases.question: How does Node decide what counts as public API versus internal — are underscore-prefixed properties like tlsSocket._handle covered by semver?
cases.note: Undocumented _-prefixed properties are internal; changing them can be semver-patch/minor unless it breaks the ecosystem.

cases.task: Revert "deps,lib,tools: remove jitless and lite modes"
cases.question: How do I revert a commit that already landed on main, and what labels should the revert PR carry?
cases.note: Use git revert <HASH> and open a normal PR; add dont-land-on-v?.x labels and remove semver-*/notable-change.

cases.task: crypto: fix X509 curve name crash for non-NIST curves
cases.question: Which GitHub team should I mention to get reviewers for a crypto change, and where is the list of teams per subsystem?
cases.note: Who-to-CC table maps lib/{crypto,tls,https} and src/crypto to @nodejs/crypto.

cases.task: Landing an approved pull request with the commit-queue label
cases.question: The commit-queue label was removed from my PR with a failure comment; what does a PR need for the queue to land it?
cases.note: Whole doc: approval/wait-time rules, CI, hard-failure retry, and limitations (fresh CI/approval since last change, commit messages, main).

cases.task: [v22.x] deps: update undici to 6.29.1
cases.question: This change doesn't apply cleanly to v22.x; how do I prepare a backport PR for that release line?
cases.note: Automated git node backport and manual cherry-pick steps, PR target/title, and backport label updates.

cases.task: [v24.x] deps: update undici to 7.30.1
cases.question: How do commits on main end up in release lines like v24.x, and what do labels like dont-land-on-v24.x mean?
cases.note: Cherry-pick flow from main to staging branches; dont-land-on/backport label meanings; releaser branch-diff excluding labels.

cases.task: 2026-10-28, Version 26.13.0 'Lithium' (LTS)
cases.question: How do I prepare an LTS release proposal, including generating the changelog and creating the release commit?
cases.note: Release steps 1-6: LTS staging rules, proposal branch/automation, version, changelog-maker, release commit, proposal PR.

cases.task: doc: add documentation for the new release schedule
cases.question: How does the new release schedule work — what are alpha releases and how do they relate to Current and LTS lines?
cases.note: Yearly schedule, October branch-off with first Alpha at prior line's LTS, Alpha semver-majors, April out-of-Alpha to Current.

cases.task: doc: add rafael and antoine as last security release stewards
cases.question: Where is the rotation of security release stewards recorded, and how is the steward for the next release picked?
cases.note: Stewards table (company, person, date, upcoming rotation); stewards nominated via TSC issue and TSC consensus.

cases.task: build: fix overriding node_path in GN build
cases.question: How do I build Node.js with GN instead of gyp locally to verify a fix to the GN build files?
cases.note: Install depot_tools, fetch node (node-ci checkout), tools/gn-gen.py out/Release, then ninja -C out/Release node.

cases.task: Iterating on C++ changes in src/ and wanting faster incremental rebuilds
cases.question: Can I build Node.js with Ninja instead of make to get faster incremental rebuilds, and how do I set it up?
cases.note: Short single-topic doc: ./configure --ninja then make; parallel jobs, debug builds, custom NINJA path.

dropped.task: test: run node-bench tools test sequentially
dropped.question: What kinds of tests belong in test/sequential rather than test/parallel, and what makes a test unsafe to parallelize?
dropped.reason: Test directory section only links to test/README.md, outside the KB; port-0 and 'default to test/parallel' remarks are tangential.

dropped.task: src: use native CopyArrayBufferBytes for webstream buffer copy
dropped.question: make lint-cpp reports style errors in my src/ changes; how do I automatically format the C++ code to fix them?
dropped.reason: No doc covers automatic C++ formatting (make format-cpp or clang-format). cpp-style-guide#formatting only says make lint-cpp runs cpplint and lists rules to follow by hand.

dropped.task: doc,crypto: mark raw key formats as stable
dropped.question: What do I need to change to promote an experimental API to stable, and does that need any special approval?
dropped.reason: The KB has no general way to promote an experimental API to stable. The only exit criteria are for Node-API (adding-new-napi-api#process-and-approval), which does not apply to other APIs.

dropped.question: How should the commit message subject be formatted when a change touches several subsystems like build, doc and tools?
dropped.reason: pull-requests gives only the single-subsystem prefix format and says several subsystems may be valid, never how to combine them in the subject.

dropped.task: Getting set up as a newly nominated Node.js collaborator
dropped.question: What happens during onboarding for a newly nominated collaborator, and what should be set up beforehand, like two-factor auth?
dropped.reason: The collaborator onboarding guide is the repo-root onboarding.md, outside doc/contributing; only steward/ambassador onboarding is covered.

dropped.task: Preparing a fix for a privately reported vulnerability ahead of a security release
dropped.question: How do I submit and get review for a fix to an embargoed vulnerability without it becoming public before the release?
dropped.reason: Docs only cover steward/releaser handling of nodejs-private patches, not how a fix author submits and gets private review.
